Legal specialisations for complex contexts.

The Circosta Law Firm assists companies, institutions and individuals in cross-border matters: transnational contracts, international litigation and arbitration, corporate and commercial law, compliance and risk management, canon and ecclesiastical law and the protection of human rights, with a focus on compliance with international standards and treaties.

Alongside its international practice, the Firm's Italian branch provides legal defence and advice in civil, criminal and administrative proceedings, as well as assistance in cyber crime matters.
